name: @rebasepro/mcp-apps
description: MCP App views for Rebase: the collection table a client like Claude shows tool results in, built from the Rebase UI kit.

scripts.prepack: node -e "const ua=process.env.npm_config_user_agent||'';if(ua.startsWith('pnpm'))process.exit(0);const p=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('package.json','utf8'));const d=Object.assign({},p.dependencies,p.peerDependencies);const ws=Object.entries(d).filter(([,v])=>String(v).startsWith('workspace:'));if(ws.length){console.error('ERROR: workspace: protocol found — use pnpm publish, not npm publish. Deps:',JSON.stringify(ws));process.exit(1)}"
scripts.build: vite build --config vite.views.config.ts && vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
